name: claude-pet
description: A desktop pet that lives alongside Claude Code

scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer/styles/pets && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/styles/*.css dist/renderer/styles/ && cp src/renderer/styles/pets/*.css dist/renderer/styles/pets/
scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:web && npm run build:assets
scripts.watch: npm run build:assets && (tsc -p tsconfig.node.json -w & tsc -p tsconfig.web.json -w)
